override_value.value: GCPRO serves homeowners across Chicago and Chicagoland. Explore local service information, or contact our team to discuss your property’s location.
Useful starting points when you are considering restoration work for your home.
What should I share when contacting GCPRO?
Tell us your property address, what happened, which rooms or belongings are affected and how we can reach you. If you already have photographs, mention them when discussing the property.
Which restoration service does my home need?
Water, fire, smoke, mold and storm damage can affect a home in different ways. Describe what you have noticed so the team can discuss an assessment and the appropriate next steps.
Can restoration include rebuilding damaged areas?
GCPRO offers reconstruction as well as restoration services. The work needed for your home, including affected finishes, is determined through the assessment and agreed project scope.
Can you help with affected belongings?
Personal property restoration is one of GCPRO’s residential services. Discuss the affected items with the team so their condition and restoration needs can be reviewed.
Do you serve my Chicagoland community?
GCPRO serves Chicago and surrounding Chicagoland communities. Use the Service Areas directory to explore local information and contact the team to confirm your property’s location.
Where can I see examples of your restoration work?
The comparisons above use actual GCPRO project photographs. Open All Projects or Before & After to explore the available project information.
